config.training_mixture: half random per-user 3..7; half evenly allocated fixed 2,4,8,12,16

criteria.timing_scope: N32 K3 P30 SNR5 RSR12 random 3-7 paths; 100 paired worlds, three serial repeats

training_duration.definition: Main training span from earliest worker manifest to final latest checkpoint; excludes preflight and data preparation. Accumulated epoch worker time includes training and validation, with overlapping workers; it is not CPU time.

uncertainty: 4000 paired world resamples, conditional on three trained models; seed variation reported separately
averaging: mean of per-training-seed dB summaries, not an ensemble of predictions
